claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Atorvastatin is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen at 2.5 uM, since HMGCR inhibition is cytostatic rather than cytotoxic and no off-target killing mechanism is evident at this concentration.
